scope: Independent read-only production-code review of the exact CPU skin reader optimization
reviewed: Each chair update refreshes cached bone world×inverse products after parent/model world matrices update.
Morph influences, bind matrices, geometry position/index/weight attributes are read live.
Maps and scratch vectors are reader-instance-local; sharing a skeleton retains per-mesh bind transforms.
Chair support uses its own dense probes; skipped body-clearance probes are not consumed by updateChair. Switching to other props refreshes them before use.
The reader allocates plain CPU matrices/vectors only; existing idempotent prop disposal neither mutates nor disposes the master geometry.
limitations: No browser launched; root owns visual QA.
Independent review did not rerun the CPU benchmark; performance percentage belongs to the implementation benchmark.
